name: database-cli
description: CLI-first database investigation Skill with read-only defaults and explicit write opt-in.

interface.longDescription: Use Database CLI to inspect database schema, search metadata across visible schemas, run safe SQL with read-only defaults, compare records across environments, and produce or execute explicitly approved repair SQL through the local CLI workflow. MCP is an optional adapter over the same CLI.
defaultPrompt: Use Database CLI to inspect a database schema.
Use Database CLI to run safe SQL with read-only defaults and explicit write opt-in.
